lin-nay-chi-kyaw.content:
Since joining Sa Kyi, I've gained so much more confidence that i can truly achieve the body goals and lifestyle I want. I'm also really grateful to all the doctors and the ladies who always care for me and make me feel like they're always there by my side throughout this journey. 
Sometimes, when I feel discouraged and start thinking,"Maybe I can't do this. Maybe I won't be able to change," I remember the words my doctor has told me. Hearing those words in my mind gives me the motivation to believe, "I can do this. I will make it happen." 
Even though there are times when I feel like my journey is moving more slowly than I expected because of different circumstances, I'll keep going until I reach the finish line. 
And to the Sa Kyi Team, I hope you'll continue to grow and achieve even greater success, and please continue to be by my side throughout this journey.😁🫶

ma-pan-nu.content:
When I first started this journey, I joined Sa Kyi wondering, “Will this really work for me?” And now, I can’t believe it’s already been a whole year~~~ I honestly never thought I would be able to stay this committed to myself for this long.
I’m truly grateful to Sa Kyi for not only guiding me toward a healthy lifestyle based on my individual needs, but also for giving me so much mental and emotional support along the way. It really feels like I’ve found a place where I can feel safe, supported, and truly rely on. 🫶🏻
Whenever I feel discouraged or want to give up, Sayar Swan has always encouraged me, guided me, and helped me get back on the right track.
I’m also so thankful to Pho for introducing me to Sa Kyi, Chue for caring for me consistently from day one, and the entire Sa Kyi Team for always being there for me. 🫰🏻

hnin-oo-yin.content:
I first heard about Sa Kyi through Pho’s blogs. Her posts gave me a lot of motivation, and I became curious to learn more about the things she shared. That’s what encouraged me to try Sa Kyi and eventually join the program.
One of the things I love most is having the opportunity to discuss my progress with the doctor every week.
Before joining Sa Kyi, whenever I went to the gym, I found activities like walking on the treadmill or cycling really exhausting, and I couldn’t keep up with them for long. But now, following the steps and exercises given by my doctor, I can work out for an hour without even realizing how quickly the time passes!
I really enjoy this approach, and that’s why I’ll definitely continue my journey with Sa Kyi. 🫶🏻

shin-thant.content:

ma-nay-chi-lin.content:

hsu-thiri-soe.content:
Since joining Sa Kyi, I’ve learned so much about how to take better care of myself and live a healthier lifestyle. It’s not just about losing weight anymore I’ve become much more aware of and focused on my overall health.
My doctor always reminds me that being healthy also includes taking care of our mental well-being, and I’ve learned a lot from that.

ma-ar-mee.content:
It’s been over two months since I joined Sakyi, and when I think about what has changed since then, there’s actually so much.
Before joining, I used to eat outside food about three times a week, along with snacks. But now, I rarely eat outside food or snacks. Instead of following a strict diet, I’ve learned how to eat healthier by simply paying more attention to my portions and plating.
The biggest change for me is that I’ve learned to stay active and feel lighter in my daily life. These days, I get at least 12,000 steps a day. Even my sleep is carefully monitored not just how long I sleep, but whether I’m actually getting good-quality rest.
I also have a one-on-one discussion with my doctor every week. My doctor plans my workouts based on what I need to do that week, and the following week, we review whether I was able to follow the plan and what I can improve.
Since my doctor is also a medical professional, I receive proper guidance not only about my health but also about mindfulness and how to practice it. Even when I feel stressed, I’ve learned how to manage it and get through it much better.
I used to get sick quite often, but surprisingly, I haven’t even had a headache once in these past two months.
One thing my doctor always reminds me of is that if we want a healthy body and a healthy lifestyle, the number on the weighing scale shouldn’t be the main focus.
Now, my clothes feel looser, I feel lighter and more comfortable, and I’ve gained so much more confidence.
The entire Sa Kyi Team is always there to encourage me and make me feel like I’m never alone on this journey. I’m truly grateful to my doctor and every single member of the team for all the support and encouragement. It really gives me the strength to keep going.
Now that I’ve completed two months, I’ll continue this journey with Sakyi until I reach the goals I want to achieve.
Wishing the entire Sa Kyi Team even more growth and success in the future! 🫶🏻

khaing-su-lwin.content:
I’m not very good at writing reviews, but I wanted to share my experience. 🥹
I joined Sa Kyi to work on my body transformation, and after two months, the change that makes me happiest is that my double chin has significantly reduced and is almost gone!
I’ve also developed a habit of drinking more water, and I now have a much better understanding of how to balance and portion my meals properly.
I still want to keep working toward my goals and continue improving myself. I’m truly grateful to the entire Sa Kyi Team for always putting in so much effort and supporting me with such warmth and care.
I definitely want to continue this journey with Sa Kyi! 💖💖💖💖
